Reviewed backend/src/scripts/persistent-battle-e2e.test.ts: Accepted ADR0076 revision1 remaining164 enforcement and existing physical-accounting contract. Observer projection now uses min(normal immutable200 maximum, approved run ceiling), while generic estimated-over-budget and exact-run approval rejection remain. Provider run persists the actual164 ceiling and transactional admission denies the next transport after the cap; no unknown replay or cap increase. Focused36pass; typecheck/static/build validation; full governed suite follows individual resealing. Preserved coverage: persistent battle E2E runner; rejects a successful health response from a different backend revision; classifies every observation provider operation under one revision; requires an exact operator approval and rejects an over-budget observation; uses the approved lower physical ceiling without changing the immutable normal policy maximum; accepts only a terminal reconciled physical-attempt ledger; generates a strong ephemeral password within the Supabase limit; accepts only a bounded portable observation run ID; validates and durably records a sanitized observation; accepts only an explicitly allowed HTTPS origin; derives the normal observation bound from the 36-tick policy; takes the authoritative done battle from an SSE response; accepts sparse strictly increasing narration sequences from a completed beat; rejects an SSE error without a done event; retries only explicit SSE BATTLE_BUSY with the same idempotency key; fails immediately for non-busy and ambiguous SSE outcomes; never retries a busy error after an execution progress event; counts requests and waits against the absolute busy deadline; bounds persistent contention without advancing the request identity; uses committed turn receipts for battle binding v7 while retaining older canonical transition requirements
